page_data.en:
MEMORANDUM

Blueshirts - Fascisti Movement in China

1) Origin of Lan-i-she (Blueshirts Association)
A Fascist movement in China is said to have been General Chiang Kai-shek's ambition ever since his latest return to the politics. This ambition was brought to life when General Chen Li-fu (陳立夫)①, his closest collaborator, organized a secret political society "Si-si-yuen" (西西園)② (West-West-Garden) with General Chen Kuo-fu (陳果夫), his elder brother at its head. The society changed its name after the inauguration and became "Blueshirts Groups" (Lan-i-tuan) of Chinese Nationalist Party. But, as a result of a reasoning that it is not proper to have any specific group among one party and start a sectarian movement, the society changed its name again and was called "Blueshirts Association". It was decided at the same time that the Association should have groups among its own organization.

2) Organization.
Members of this Association were temporarily limited to 3,000, of which 2,000 men should come from the graduates of Whampoa Military Academy and the rest should be chosen among the people at large. Mr. Ho Chung-han (賀衷寒) was made the general secretary, General Chen Kuo-fu, assisted by Generals Chen Li-fu, Cheng Tien-fang (程天放)④ and Chang Tao-fan (張道藩)⑤, occupied a position similar to a Chief-of-Staff in an army. Leaders in the Central organization were 13 altogether. The Association established its branches in every part of the country where there is a local organ of Nationalist Party. The branch officers picked
page_data.zh:
备忘录

蓝衣社——中国的法西斯运动

1) 蓝衣社（兰衣社）的起源
据说，自蒋介石将军最近重返政坛以来，在中国开展一场法西斯运动便是他的夙愿。当他的最亲密合作者陈立夫将军①与其兄陈果夫将军组织一个名为“西西园”②的秘密政治社团时，这一愿望得以实现。该社团在成立后更改名称，成为中国国民党的“蓝衣团”。但是，基于在一党之内设立特定团体并发起派系运动是不妥当的推论，该社团再次更名，称为“蓝衣社”。同时决定，该社在其组织内部应设有各个小组。

2) 组织。
该社成员暂时限制为3,000人，其中2,000人应来自黄埔军校毕业生，其余从普通民众中挑选。贺衷寒先生任总秘书，陈果夫将军在陈立夫、程天放④将军和张道藩⑤将军的协助下，占据类似军队参谋长的职位。中央组织的领导人共有13人。该社在有国民党地方机构的全国各地建立了分支。分支官员挑选

page_data.en:
- 2 -

up the loyal members of the Party and made them the
members of the Branch, its purpose being to grasp the
dominent power in the 5th General Meeting of Kuomintang.
3) The purpose of the Association.
    The purpose is to establish a central political
power, which should be stabilized under the dictatorship
of General Chiang Kai-shek. To attain this, the
Association wants to develop three movements :-
a) Chien-Chun-Yun-Tung (The movement to make army sound).
    1) To watch generals in various parts of the country.
    2) To seize the de facto power of the existing generals.
    3) "Fascinization" of the Chinese armies.
    4) The most important part of the Association should
       be occupied by the milito-political students' group
       and Political Students' Group at the Political
       Training Institute.
b) Chien-Tang-Yun-Tung (The movement to make the party
   sound).
    1) To drive out all the party leaders of the various
       cliques and keep party business under the influence
       of the Association.
    2) To restore the presidentship in the party.
    3) To send the efficient elements of the Association
       to the local Tangpus in order to safeguard the
       Fascist movement of the Association.
c) Chien-Tsai-Yun-Tung (The movement to make the finance
   sound).
    1) Equalization of land rights (to maintain the
       territorial rights).
    2) To raise loans in the name of state-owned
       enterprises and provide the Fascist movement
       with material supports.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

忠诚的党员成为分支成员，其目的是在国民党第五次全国代表大会上掌握主导权。
3) 该社的宗旨。
    宗旨是建立一个中央政治权力，并在蒋介石将军的独裁统治下予以稳固。为实现此目标，
该社希望开展三项运动：-
a) 建军运动（使军队健全的运动）。
    1) 监视全国各地的将领。
    2) 夺取现有将领的实际权力。
    3) 中国军队的“法西斯化”。
    4) 该社最重要的部分应由军事政治学生群体和政治训练所的政治学生群体占据。
b) 建党运动（使政党健全的运动）。
   1) 驱逐各派系的所有党派领导人，使党务在该社的影响之下。
   2) 恢复党内的总裁制。
   3) 将该社的精干分子派往各地党部，以保卫该社的法西斯运动。
c) 建财运动（使财政健全的运动）。
   1) 地权平均化（以维持领土权利）。
   2) 以国有企业名义举借贷款，为法西斯运动提供物质支持。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

By these three movements, the Association tries
to grasp all the powers, military, party and financial,
in its own hands.

4) Policies of the Association :
a) Propaganda Policy :
It aims at a unity of national views through its
organs, such as Chung-Kuo-Jih-Pao (China Daily News),
Ping-Ming-Wan-Pao (Common People's Evening News),
Nin-Min-Wan-Pao (People's Evening News), Wen-Hua-Jih-
Pao (Culture Daily News), Wen-Hua Chou-Pao (Culture
Weekly), Nin-Min-Chou-Pao (People's Weekly) and
Cheng-Chih-Ping-Lun (Political Review).
This line of work is covered by Generals Cheng
Tien-fang, Shao Yuan-ch'ung ⑥ (邵元冲) and Chen Pu-
lei ⑦ (陳布雷).

b) Financial Policy :
The Association follows the policy laid down by
Mr.T.V.Soong. It aims at inducing all the compradores
in Shanghai and their subordinates to the support of the
Association.

c) Educational Policy :
Mr. Chu Chia-hwa ⑧ (朱家驊), ex-Minister of Education
and General Chen Kuo-fu are in charge of this line of
work. The Association tried to remodel the Educational
Council at first and established a new committee in the
Education Ministry, General Chen Kuo-fu being the
chairman. Among the members of this committee,
such as Messrs. Yang Kung-tah ⑨ (楊公達) and Ho Hao-juo ⑩
(何浩若) are affiliated with the Association. These
fascists believe that Social Science Departments in
various Universities are hot beds for dangerous and
reactionary ideas. Hence their abolition has been
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

通过这三项运动，该社试图将军事、党务和财政所有权力掌握在自己手中。

4) 该社的政策：
a) 宣传政策：
旨在通过其机关报刊，如《中国日报》、《平民晚报》、《人民晚报》、《文化日报》、《文化周报》、《人民周报》和《政治评论》，统一国民观点。
这项工作由程天放将军、邵元冲⑥将军和陈布雷⑦将军负责。

b) 财政政策：
该社遵循宋子文先生制定的政策。旨在诱导上海所有的买办及其下属支持该社。

c) 教育政策：
前教育部长朱家骅⑧先生和陈果夫将军负责这方面的工作。该社起初试图改组教育委员会，并在教育部成立了一个新委员会，由陈果夫将军担任主席。在该委员会成员中，杨公达⑨先生和何浩若⑩先生等人隶属于该社。这些法西斯分子认为，各大学的社会科学系是危险和反动思想的温床。因此，废除这些系科已被

page_data.en:
- 4 -

taken up as the preliminary task. Many student
troubles were fomented only in order to attain
this destructive purpose. For instance, recent
trouble in the Central University at Nanking is
believed to be a direct result of the collision
between Minister Chu of Chiang Kai-shek Party and
Dean Tuan Yang-seng (段朋) of Waung Ching-wei
Party.

5) Foreign Policy :
a) In order to combine with fascist parties in Italy
and Germany, and promote the friendship with them,
Liu Wen-tao (劉文島) and H.H. Kung, the present
Chairman of Central Bank of China, were sent to
Germany and Italy respectively.
b) To send Fascist Training Corps to Germany and realize
a mutual aid between German and Chinese fascists.

6) Internal Policy :
a) All those opposing to Blueshirts Movement should be
exiled out of the Kuomintang as reactionaries and
be attacked as political enemies.
b) As regards to communists, the Act for encouraging
the communists' self-denunciation should be
effectively enforced and provide them with special
organ to accommodate the converted. After a
certain period of remodeling in this organ, the
converted should be given the membership of the
Ian-i-she.

Liang Kan-chiao (梁幹喬), leading communist
commander and graduate of Whampoa Military Academy,
should be marked for some time in order to pursuade
him to convert, and, under some circumstance or
other, the extension of Soviet district to Kwangtung
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

列为初步任务。许多学生骚乱仅仅是为了实现这一破坏性目的而煽动起来的。例如，最近南京中央大学的骚乱被认为是蒋介石派的朱部长与汪精卫派的段朋院长之间冲突的直接结果。

5) 外交政策：
a) 为了与意大利和德国的法西斯政党联合并促进与它们的友谊，刘文岛和现任中国银行董事长孔祥熙分别被派往德国和意大利。
b) 向德国派遣法西斯训练团，实现德中法西斯主义者之间的互助。

6) 内政政策：
a) 所有反对蓝衣社运动的人都应作为反动派被逐出国民党，并作为政治敌人受到攻击。
b) 关于共产党人，应有效执行鼓励共产党人自首的法令，并为他们提供专门的机构以容纳悔过者。经过该机构一定时期的改造后，悔过者应被授予兰衣社的成员资格。

梁干乔，共产党主要指挥官之一，黄埔军校毕业生，应在一段时间内加以标记以便劝其转化，并且在某种情况下，应默许苏区扩展至广东省，以根除那里的反蒋运动。满洲问题解决后，应开始对“赤色分子”进行大规模镇压。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

Province should be acquiesced in order to root out the
anti-Chiang movement there. After the settlement of
Manchurian problem, the wholesale suppression against
the 'reds should be started.

7) Terrorist Policy :

The Association has the Assassination Corps, which
is divided into two departments :-

a) Detective Department :

1) Military Secret Service
Wang Pai-ling (王伯齡) is in charge of this line.

2) Special Secret Service
Ku Chien-chung (顧建中) is in charge of this service,
which covers political informations.

b) Assassination Department :

1) Sniping Corps (or Blood & Iron Corps)
The head of this corps is Koo Shun-chwang
(顧順章) who was formerly a notorious communist
leader. The members are picked up among the
graduates of the Political Training Institute
of Whampoa Military Academy. General Yang Hu
(楊虎), Commissioner of Peace Maintenance
Corps at Shanghai and notorious "Ching-pang"
leader, is in charge of this training. Members
of this corps now in Shanghai are estimated to
be 200.

2) Anti-Communist Campaign Corps
Members of this corps are picked up among the
Special Corps of Public Safety Bureau.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -


7) 恐怖政策：

该社设有暗杀团，分为两个部门：-

a) 侦探部：

1) 军事情报处
王伯龄负责此项工作。

2) 特别情报处
顾建中负责此项服务，涵盖政治情报。

b) 暗杀部：

1) 狙击队（或铁血团）
该队队长是顾顺章，他曾是著名的共产党领导人。成员是从黄埔军校政治训练所的毕业生中挑选的。上海保安团专员、著名的“青帮”头目杨虎将军负责此项训练。估计目前在上海的该队成员有200人。

2) 反共运动队
该队成员是从公安局特别队中挑选的。

Subject (in full) Chinese Nazi or Fascisti Groups

Made by and Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

With reference to attached letter received by Mr.
Raphael, enquiries have failed to show the existence
among Chinese political bodies of organizations styling
themselves Nazi or Fascisti.
The principal party in China, the Kuomintang, it-
self, may be likened to both the Nazi and Fascisti in its
manner of dealing with its political opponents,
communists in particular.
Fascism in Italy is supposed to have its counter-
part in China in the Nationalist Youth Party which was
first formed by a group of Chinese students studying in
France with headquarters in Paris and under the leader-
ship of one, Tseng E (曾琦). It claims to have a
membership of some 350 persons mostly from educational
circles in Peiping and Shanghai. Local followers include
Wong Tsao-dz (王造時), a professor in the Kuang Hua
University, Tu Tieh-sai (杜鐵珊), teacher in the Bei
Ming Girls Middle School, 32 Markham Road and Dzung Si-
kuo (鄭思恭), teacher of the Hua Tung Middle School,
Rue Amiral Bayle. Its policy is to advocate the
establishment of a constitutional government as the
best means of bringing China into line with first class
powers and in its propaganda the present Nanking regime
and the Kuomintang come in for scathing criticism.
The party is regarded as reactionary by the Kuomintang
and looked upon as extreme right by the Communists with
the result that it functioned more or less secretly,
although several of its leaders were invited by the
National Government to participate in the National

中国的主要政党国民党本身，在处理其政治对手，特别是共产党人方面，可与纳粹和法西斯相提并论。
据称，意大利的法西斯主义在中国的对应物是国家青年党，该党最初由一群在法国留学的中国学生组成，总部设在巴黎，由曾琦领导。该党声称拥有约350名成员，大多来自北平和上海的教育界。当地追随者包括光华大学教授王造时、贝满女中（Markham路32号）教师杜铁珊，以及爱多亚路（Rue Amiral Bayle）华童公学教师郑思恭。其政策是主张建立宪政政府，作为使中国与一流强国接轨的最佳手段，在其宣传中，当前的南京政权和国民党受到了严厉批评。

H.Q.C.B. Station,
REPORT
Date March 23, 1933
Subject (in full) Threatening letter received by Mr. R. K. Rafael at 43 Great
Western Road
Made by D.S.I. Ovs iennikoff Forwarded by Supt. Quayle
Sir,
With reference to the attached copy of a letter addressed to
D.C. (Crime) from Mr. R. K. Rafael, dated March 21st, 1933, I beg
to report that at 10.30 a.m. on March 22nd I interviewed the
writer in his office, Room No. 35, 24 The Bund, regarding the
threatening letter dated February 18th, 1933 which was received
by him on March 21st at his home address, 43 Great Western Road.
Mr. R. K. Rafael suspects that the letter in question was sent to
him by some one connected with one of the local anti-Japanese
boycott organisations as it is known to them that during the end
of 1932 and beginning of 1933 he was selling Saigon rice on behalf
of the Japanese firm of Nippon Menkiva Kabushiki Kaisha, 8 Hankow
Road. Furthermore he already experienced some trouble with the
said organisations as evident from the attached File F.I.R. 285/33,
Misc. 27/33 of Central Station, dated February 3, 1933. Mr. R. K.
Rafael, when asked by the undersigned what protection he would
like to have in the area of his office from the Shanghai Municipal
Police, said that as he does not consider the letter to be of a
serious nature, he does not want any particular protection afford-
ed to him. He informed the Police Headquarters now as he was ins-
tructed to do so by the Police during December 1932, when he had
a similar experience. He agreed to inform the office of the
Crime Branch Headquarters immediately on receipt of any further
threatening letter and also in case of anything unusual that will
raise his suspicions.
I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
V. Ovs iennikoff
D.S.I.

由副督察奥夫谢尼科夫（Ovs iennikoff）呈报，经警司奎尔（Quayle）转呈

阁下：

关于附件中R. K. 拉斐尔先生于1933年3月21日致刑事科副主任的信件副本，本人谨此报告，我于3月22日上午10时30分在其办公室（外滩24号35室）会见了写信人，就其于3月21日在寓所（戈登路43号）收到的1933年2月18日的恐吓信一事进行问询。

R. K. 拉斐尔先生怀疑该信是由当地某个抵制日货组织的关联人士寄出的，因为对方知晓他在1932年底和1933年初曾代表位于汉口路8号的日本公司“日本棉业株式会社”（Nippon Menkiva Kabushiki Kaisha）销售西贡大米。此外，正如中央巡捕房1933年2月3日的档案F.I.R. 285/33及杂项档案27/33所示，他此前已与上述组织发生过一些纠纷。当本人询问拉斐尔先生希望上海公共租界工部局警务处在其办公区域提供何种保护时，他表示由于他认为该信件性质并不严重，因此不需要为其提供特别保护。他此次通知警察总局，是因为遵照警方在1932年12月他遭遇类似事件时的指示行事。他同意一旦收到任何进一步的恐吓信，或发生任何引起他怀疑的异常情况，将立即通知刑事科总部办公室。

此致，
敬礼

CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER

EXISTENCE OF "BLUE
SHIRTS" DENIED
Nanking, Sept. 30
Recent rumours circulated in the
Japanese press alleging that "Blue
Shirts" are secretly instigating under-
ground activities in North China
again brought forth emphatic denials
from officials circles here.
In reply to an inquiry by a repre-
sentative of the Central News Agency
this morning, a member of the
Central Executive Committee of the
Kuomintang chuckled that there
never has been any so-called "Blue
Shirts" society in China.
"The alleged society," he said,
"is purely an imaginative organiza-
tion created out of the mind of the
supersensitive."—Central News.

机密
抽屉

否认“蓝衣社”存在
南京，9月30日电
近日日本报纸流传谣言，称“蓝衣社”正在华北秘密煽动地下活动，此地官方圈子对此再次予以坚决否认。
今晨，在回答中央通讯社记者的询问时，一名国民党中央执行委员会委员笑着说，中国从未有过所谓的“蓝衣社”。
他说：“所谓的那个社团，纯粹是神经过敏者臆想出来的组织。”——中央通讯社消息。

June 25, 1935. Morning Translation.

NIPPO, MAINICHI AND NICHI-NICHI

BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY ARRESTS PRO-JAPANESE
CHINESE NEWSPAPER REPORTER

A pro-Japanese Chinese
newspaper reporter who was working for co-operation
between Chinese and Japanese newspaper circles has been
arrested by the Blue Shirts Society and his life is
in danger. The victim is reported to be one Yuan Chao
Yi, Chief translator of a news agency which mainly
translates comments of foreign newspapers.
On May 14 Mr. Iwai, Chief of
the Intelligence Section of the Japanese Embassy,
entertained a number of Japanese and Chinese newspaper
reporters at the Japanese Miko Restaurant on Boone Road.
Mr. Yuan , who attended the function, delivered a
speech advocating rapprochement between Japanese and
Chinese newspaper reporters and supporting Sino-Japanese
economic co-operation. About a week later, Mr. Yuan
was reported to be missing.
Upon receiving the report ,
the "Nichi-Nichi " made an investigation through the
Shanghai Newspaper Men's Association and ascertained
that Mr. Yuan had been arrested by the Blue Shirts
Society for being pro-Japanese and that he was charged
with being traitor.
Mr. Yuan is a returned student
from Japan. He has a fair knowledge of Japanese and is
an honest advocate of Sino-Japanese rapprochement.
When he was in Japan for about a month last year he
exchanged views with a number of prominent Japanese
newspapermen at Tokyo and Osaka. He is well known to
many Japanese newspapers in Japan.
Upon receiving a report that
Mr. Yuan has been arrested by the Blue Shirts Society,
several of his friends began to work for his release, but
the Blue Shirts Society is claiming that Yuan had been
arrested for communistic activities.
Persons who know Mr. Yuan state
that this charge is absurd and that the real cause of
his arrest is due to the differences between the Blue
Shirts Society and the C. C. Corps. Mr. Yuan is a
partisan of Mr. Wu Sung Ah, Chief of the Social Bureau
of the City Government, who is the leader of the C. C.
Corps which has control over local Chinese newspapers.
The Blue Shirts Society arrested Mr. Yuan as an indirect
attack upon the C. C. Corps.
The C C. Corps is formed by
Chen Ko Fu and Chen Lih Fu, two very influential members
of the Central Kuomintang. They are opposed to the
Three Principles of the People and are the opponents of
the Blue Shirts Society which advocates a dictatorship by
Chiang Kai Shek.

1935年6月25日。上午译文。

《日日新闻》、《每日新闻》及《日日报》

蓝衣社逮捕亲华日本报纸记者

一名致力于中日新闻界合作的中国亲日报纸记者已被蓝衣社逮捕，其生命垂危。据悉受害者名为袁超义（Yuan Chao Yi，音译），是一家主要翻译外国报纸评论的新闻社的首席翻译。
5月14日，日本大使馆情报科科长岩井（Iwai，音译）先生在布恩路（Boone Road，即九江路）的日本美高餐厅（Miko Restaurant）宴请了多名中日记者。出席该活动的袁先生发表演讲，倡导中日记者和睦相处，并支持中日经济合作。约一周后，据报道袁先生失踪。
接到报告后，《日日报》通过上海新闻记者协会进行调查，查明袁先生因亲日立场被蓝衣社逮捕，并被指控为汉奸。
袁先生是一名留日归国学生。他通晓日语，是中日和睦的真诚倡导者。去年他在日本逗留约一个月期间，曾在东京和大阪与多位日本著名新闻人士交换意见。他为日本许多报社所熟知。
得知袁先生被蓝衣社逮捕的消息后，他的几位朋友开始努力争取将其释放，但蓝衣社声称袁某是因共产主义活动被捕。
了解袁先生的人士表示，这一指控荒谬不经，其被捕的真正原因在于蓝衣社与CC系之间的分歧。袁先生是市政府社会局局长吴醒亚（Wu Sung Ah，音译）的支持者，吴是控制当地中文报纸的CC系领袖。蓝衣社逮捕袁先生是对CC系的间接攻击。
CC系由国民党中央两位极具影响力的成员陈果夫（Chen Ko Fu，音译）和陈立夫（Chen Lih Fu，音译）组成。他们反对三民主义，并且是主张蒋介石独裁的蓝衣社的对手。

March 19, 1935. Morning Translation.

The Kiangnan Tseng Pao (江南正报), a Japanese newspaper, published in the Chinese language, contains the following article :-

ALLEGATIONS AGAINST CHIANG KAI SHEK.

Between January 29 and January 30, several interviews took place between General Chiang Kai Shek and Mr. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister to China, and Lieut-General Suzuki, Military Attache to the Japanese Legation at Nanking. Later Mr. Wang Ching Wei expressed his views on the desirability of Sino-Japanese collaboration. Up to the present, the National Government has not issued any mandate prohibiting the anti-Japanese movement in schools and the boycott of Japanese goods. Recently a speech delivered by Wang Ching Wei at a memorial service was published in the press as having been made by Tseu Keng Sung (周耕生), an aide-de-camp of General Chiang Kai Shek. This has raised some doubt over the sincerity of China for Sino-Japanese collaboration.

According to reliable information, General Chiang Kai Shek recently secretly dispatched members of the Blue Shirt Party to Peiping, Tientsin, Tsingtao, Shanghai, Hankow and other districts to keep a watch on the attitude of Chinese officials and civilians towards Japan. The Commissioner of the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety is usually appointed and recommended by Mayor Wu Te Chen. But this practice has now been abolished because the appointment of Tsai Ching Chun, a follower of General Chiang Kai Shek as Commissioner of the Public Safety Bureau in Shanghai was made by the National Government without recommendation from Mayor Wu Te Chen. General Tsai is a prominent member of the Blue Shirt Party.

It is learned that Kwan Ching Ling (关敬龄 ), a member of the Blue Shirt Party, will be appointed as Commissioner of the Bureau of Public Safety at Peiping.

Some time ago the National Government ordered the various missionary schools to abolish all anti-Japanese literature from the text books, but according to our investigation no such action has been taken and all these reports are but propaganda of a certain party to show that it is taking action to suppress the anti-Japanese movement.

中文出版的日文报纸《江南正报》刊登了以下文章：

针对蒋介石的指控。

1月29日至1月30日期间，蒋介石将军与日本驻华大使有吉明（Ariyoshi，音译）及日本驻南京公使馆武官铃木中将（Suzuki，音译）进行了数次会谈。随后，汪精卫先生表达了中日合作的意愿。截至目前，国民政府尚未发布任何禁止学校反日运动和抵制日货的命令。最近，报纸刊登了汪精卫在一次追悼会上的演讲，却署名为蒋介石将军的副官周耕生（Tseu Keng Sung，音译）。这引发了人们对中日合作诚意的质疑。

据可靠消息，蒋介石将军近期秘密派遣蓝衣党成员前往北平、天津、青岛、上海、汉口等地，监视中国官员和民众对日本的态度。上海市公安局局长通常由市长吴铁城推荐任命。但这一惯例现已废除，因为蔡劲军（Tsai Ching Chun，音译）作为蒋介石将军的亲信，被国民政府任命为上海市公安局局长，并未经过吴铁城市长的推荐。蔡将军是蓝衣党的 prominent 成员。

据悉，蓝衣党成员关敬龄（Kwan Ching Ling，音译）将被任命为北平市公安局局长。

前一段时间，国民政府命令各教会学校从教科书中删除所有反日文献，但据我们调查，并未采取此类行动，所有这些报道不过是某一党派为显示其正在采取行动镇压反日运动而进行的宣传。

January 9, 1935.    Afternoon Translation.

Kiangnan Tseng Pao, a Japanese newspaper published in the
Chinese language, contains the following articles:-

EXPANSION OF THE ORGANIZATION OF THE BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY

General Chiang Kai Shek is speaking loudly
about the unification of China, while the Blue Shirts
Society is expanding in the various provinces. This
movement of the Blue Shirts Society is being viewed
with considerable gravity by the military leaders of
the semi-independent provinces and as a consequence,
General Liu Wen Hui has issued a manifesto calling
for the independence of Szechuen. In Shantung the
assassination of Chang Wei Tsung, a Kuomintang member,
has taken place.
Of late, the Blue Shirts Society has been
mobilized under the name of the Kuomintang or of the
Military Affairs Commission and members of the Society
have stealthily penetrated into the semi-independent
provinces. The Central Kuomintang Headquarters at
Nanking, under the control of Chen Lih Fu, member of
the C.E.C., has become the Headquarters of the Blue
Shirts Society, and officials of the various departments
of the Kuomintang are members of the Society.
Kuomintang Affairs Re-Organization Committees have been
formed in Shantung, Hopei, Shansi, Szechuen, Yunnan,
Shensi, Chahar and other provinces and Units of the
Blue Shirts Society have been established to carry
out its policy. Whenever a new comrade is obtained,
the Society will send him to various organizations to
make an effort to secure controlling power.
This policy of the Society was discovered
in Shantung; consequently Chang Wei Tsung, who had
been sent by the Society to Shantung, was assassinated.
In Shansi, the Kuomintang Units of General Yen Sih San's
Clique are opposing the Kuomintang Affairs Re-Organization
Committee and have driven away the members directing
the Committee. Wu Kuo Kwang, a prominent leader of
the Blue Shirts Society, established a General
Headquarters in Szechuen, but this was opposed by
the various Cliques in Szechuen.
The Central Kuomintang Headquarters at Nanking
recently established a Kuomintang Affairs Working
Members Training Class and summoned members of the Tangpu
to undergo training. The Headquarters is endeavouring
to recruit 300,000 members.

1935年1月9日。下午译文。

中文出版的日文报纸《江南正报》刊登了以下文章：

蓝衣社组织的扩张

蒋介石将军高声呼吁中国统一，而蓝衣社则在各省扩张势力。半独立省份的军事领导人对蓝衣社的这一动向相当重视，因此，刘文辉将军发布了宣布四川独立的宣言。在山东，发生了国民党成员张伟宗（Chang Wei Tsung，音译）被刺杀的事件。
近来，蓝衣社以国民党或军事委员会的名义进行动员，其成员已悄然渗透进半独立省份。位于南京、由中央执行委员陈立夫控制的国民党中央总部已成为蓝衣社的总部，国民党各部门官员均为该社成员。在山东、河北、山西、四川、云南、陕西、察哈尔等省成立了国民党事务整理委员会，并建立了蓝衣社单位以执行其政策。每当发展新成员，该社便会将其派往各个组织，努力夺取控制权。
该社的这一政策在山东被发现；因此，被该社派往山东的张伟宗遭到刺杀。在山西，阎锡山将军派系的国民党单位反对国民党事务整理委员会，并驱逐了指导委员会的成员。蓝衣社著名领导人吴国光（Wu Kuo Kwang，音译）在四川建立了总指挥部，但遭到四川各派系的反对。
南京国民党中央总部最近设立了国民党事务工作人员训练班，召集黄埔军校成员受训。总部正努力招募30万名成员。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 16, 1933

"BLUE SHIRTS" AGAIN

General Chiang Kai-shek and other high officials of the Government have repeatedly denied all knowledge of the existence of any Fascist society known as the "Blue Shirts", and these denials cannot be affected by reports of their activities which continue to come from Canton and from sources in Shanghai known to be opposed to their alleged programme of government. So far as can be ascertained, this programme revolves round a restoration of the presidency of the Kuomintang, instead of the presidium of three which now exists in name but not in fact; and a scheme of reconstruction which embodies many of the principles of the National Socialists in Germany. Other items on their programme are said to include the reform of the army and its unity under one central command, and certain changes in the educational system of the country which will withhold the strong potions of advanced political science and economy until the student is of an age and experience not to have his head turned by them. These principles seem to be within the scope of the San Min Chu I. The "Blue Shirts", however, are said to favour a slight modification of the third or Principle of Livelihood, and it seems to be on this point and on the suspicion that personalities play as important a part as principles in the alleged Fascist movement, that the orthodox members of the Kuomintang are so bitterly opposed to it. So long as a rigid interpretation of the Kuomintang doctrine is insisted upon, it may be expected that those who believe that modifications of it would be an improvement should be driven to form secret associations for the propagation of their beliefs. That is a fault with every system which admits difference from itself as heresy. It can only be overcome when freedom of speech and belief are freely granted to the people.

《字林西报》，1933年8月16日，星期三

“蓝衣社”再起

蒋介石将军及其他政府高官已多次否认知晓任何名为“蓝衣社”的法西斯团体的存在，尽管来自广州以及上海方面已知反对其所谓治国纲领的消息源不断传来有关其活动的报道，但这些否认并未因此受到影响。据目前所能查明，该纲领的核心在于恢复国民党主席制，以取代当前名义上存在但实际并未运作的三人主席团；并推行一项重建计划，其中体现了许多德国国家社会主义的原则。据说其纲领的其他项目还包括军队改革及其在单一中央指挥下的统一，以及对国家教育体系的某些变革，即在学生年龄尚轻、阅历不足、易受高深政治学与经济学强烈影响而迷失方向之前，暂缓传授这些内容。这些原则似乎都在三民主义的范畴之内。然而，据说“蓝衣社”倾向于对第三项原则即民生主义稍作修改，国民党的正统成员之所以如此激烈地反对该运动，似乎正是基于这一点，以及怀疑在该所谓的法西斯运动中，个人因素所起的作用与原则同样重要。只要坚持对国民党教义进行僵化的解释，那些认为对其加以修改会有所改善的人便难免被迫组成秘密协会以传播其信念。这是任何将异见视为异端的体制所共有的弊病。唯有当人民被自由赋予言论和信仰自由时，这一弊病才能得以克服。

August 14, 1933. Morning Translation 4685
Date 14 / 8 / 33

MISCELLANEOUS

Siao Kung Pao (小公報), a mosquito paper, published the
following article on August 12:-

BLUE SHIRTS PREPARING TO ASSASSINATE OPPONENTS.

Wild reports of assassination are rife
following the publication by the Shanghai Evening News
& Mercury the other day of an article containing a secret
order of the Blue Shirts Society and a list of names
of distinguished persons to be assassinated. However,
the identity of the assassination gang is not known.
Of late, wild rumours of assassination have
been in circulation. Last night, this paper secured
the following assassination schemes of the Blue Shirts
Society, disclosed by a local member of the Society:-
"Fifty-seven persons (list of whose names is
not available), divided into 14 Corps, are engaged in the
assassination service in Shanghai, under the leadership
of Tai Li (戴笠) and Tsu Yung Shing (趙永興). The
headquarters of these 14 Corps are:-
(1) Six Corps in the French Concession:
One Corps in Joffre Terrace, one Corps in Lafayette
Terrace, one Corps in Garden Terrace, Route Pere
Robert and three other Corps in Zikawei, Rue Tourane,
etc.
(2) Five Corps in the International Settlement:
Bubbling Well Road, Yu Yuen Road, Connaught Road,
Sinza Road, etc.
(3) Three Corps in Chinese controlled territory:
Lunghwa, Nantao, Kaochongmiao, etc.
"The method adopted will be for members of the
Society to first detect the whereabouts of persons whose
elimination has been decided upon and then carry out the
assassination. These will be shot at sight by members
in possession of pistols.
"Assassination members are mostly disguised as
ricsha coolies, hawkers or fortune tellers and post
themselves in the same district as persons destined for
assassination. They are armed with pistols.
"Since their return to Shanghai from Lusan to
await instructions from General Chiang Kai Shek, local
assassination members of the Society have been becoming
increasingly active. Drastic training of secret service
members is under way in the headquarters of the Society
and the selection of assassination members to carry out
the work in all districts is being made."

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

VULCANIZING WORKS IN SETTLEMENT.

At 4 p.m. to-day the Machine-made Native Goods
Factory Owners Federation, the Industrial & Commercial
Control Cooperative Association and the Industrial Safety
Cooperative Association will hold a meeting in the latter's
office on Rue Pottier in the French Concession to discuss
ways and means of dealing with the warnings issued by the
S.M.C. and the F.M.C. ordering many Chinese rubber
factories to vacate their premises.

《小公報》（Siao Kung Pao），一份小型报刊，于8月12日刊登了以下文章：

蓝衣社准备刺杀反对者。

继《上海晚邮报》（Shanghai Evening News & Mercury）日前刊登了一篇包含蓝衣社秘密命令及待刺杀知名人士名单的文章后，关于刺杀的荒诞报道甚嚣尘上。然而，该刺杀团伙的身份尚不为人知。近来，关于刺杀的谣言四处流传。昨晚，本报从该社一名本地成员处获悉以下蓝衣社刺杀方案：

“五十七人（名单暂缺），分为14个队，在戴笠（Tai Li）和趙永興（Tsu Yung Shing）的领导下，在上海从事刺杀活动。这14个队的总部所在地如下：
(1) 法租界内有六个队：
一个队在霞飞坊（Joffre Terrace），一个队在辣斐德坊（Lafayette Terrace），一个队在花园坊（Garden Terrace）、神父路（Route Pere Robert），另外三个队在徐家汇（Zikawei）、图兰路（Rue Tourane）等地。
(2) 公共租界内有五个队：
静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）、愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）、康纳脱路（Connaught Road）、新闸路（Sinza Road）等地。
(3) 华界内有三个队：
龙华、南市、高昌庙等地。

“采取的方法是，由社团成员首先侦测已被决定清除之人的行踪，然后实施刺杀。这些目标将被持有手枪的成员见即射杀。

“刺杀成员大多伪装成黄包车夫、小贩或算命先生，并潜伏在与预定刺杀对象相同的区域。他们配备手枪。

“自从从庐山返回上海等待蒋介石将军的指示以来，该社本地的刺杀成员日益活跃。社团总部正在对特务成员进行严厉训练，并正在选拔刺杀成员以在各地区执行任务。”

Extract from French Police Daily Intelligence Report

ACTIVITY OF CHINESE FASCISTS ("BLUE SHIRTS")

We learn that a conference was held recently at Lushan
attended by Chiang Kai Shek, Chen Li Fu (陳立夫), member of
the Central Executive Committee and Chief of the Organization
Department of the Kuomintang; Tseng Kwang Ching (曾擴情),
member of the Central Executive Committee and special delegate
of the Kuomintang in Szechuan; Wu Hsing Ya (吳醒亞), member of
the Standing Committee of the local Kuomintang Headquarters
and Chief of the Bureau of Social Affairs; Pang Kung Tsai
(潘公展), member of the Standing Committee of the local
Kuomintang Headquarters and Chief of the Bureau of Public
Instructions in Shanghai, etc. etc.

During the course of the conference development of
the Fascist movement in China was discussed. It was decided
to establish, in the first place, fascist cells in the
Kuomintang Headquarters, in "loyal" military units and in
schools and universities. This work will be conducted in a
semi-official manner and will be directed :- in Shanghai by
Wu Hsing Ya and Pang Kung Tsai; in Hupeh by Chiang Chi Cheng
(蔣堅忍), Chief of the General Staff of the Wuhan Military
Headquarters and Commanding officer of the armoured trains
detachment of the Central Military Headquarters; in Kiangsi
by Ho Tsung Han (賀衷寒), Chief of Political Instruction Service
of the Kiangsi Military Headquarters; in Hunan by Kang Chih
(康澤), member of the Hunan Provincial Bureau of the Kuomintang;
in Szechuan by Tseng Kwang Ching, etc.

We are informed, among other things, that the
influence of the fascist elements begins to be more and more
noticeable in the following universities: Sun Yat Sen (Canton),
Central (Nanking), Hukan (Kaifeng) and Chiinan (Shanghai).
Chen Fang Nien (鄭洪年), Director of the latter university, is
said to have joined the Fascist Party in the beginning of 1933.

中国法西斯分子（“蓝衣社”）的活动

据悉，近期在庐山召开了一次会议，出席者包括蒋介石、国民党中央执行委员会委员兼组织部部长陈立夫（Chen Li Fu）、国民党中央执行委员会委员兼国民党驻四川特派员曾擴情（Tseng Kwang Ching）、当地国民党总部常务委员会委员兼社会局局长吴醒亚（Wu Hsing Ya）、当地国民党总部常务委员会委员兼上海市教育局局长潘公展（Pang Kung Tsai）等。

会议期间讨论了中国法西斯运动的发展问题。决定首先在国民党总部、“忠诚”军事单位以及学校和大学中建立法西斯小组。这项工作将以半官方方式进行，并由以下人员指导：在上海由吴醒亚和潘公展负责；在湖北由武汉行营参谋长兼中央军事总部装甲列车分队指挥官蔣堅忍（Chiang Chi Cheng）负责；在江西由江西行营政治训练处处长賀衷寒（Ho Tsung Han）负责；在湖南由国民党湖南省党部委员康澤（Kang Chih）负责；在四川由曾擴情负责，等等。

另据告知，法西斯元素的影响在以下大学中开始日益显著：中山大学（广州）、中央大学（南京）、河南大学（开封，原文为Hukan）和暨南大学（上海）。据说暨南大学校长鄭洪年（Chen Fang Nien）已于1933年初加入法西斯党。

MISCELLANEOUS

Yien Dai (現代) Literary and Art Club, the Youth (青年)
Literary and Art Club, the Huang Mo (荒漠) Literary
and Art Club, the China Territorial Protection League,
the Jih Kwang Drama Club and the Chinese Women's Emanci-
pation Association.
After the proceedings, the presidium made a
report on the significance of the welcome to Mr. Barbusse,
delegate of the Anti-War League to visit China, and urged
the public to join the movement for world peace and for
the benefit of mankind.
Our reporter was informed by one of the delegates
of the meeting that the expenses incurred in the prepara-
tions for the same were raised by subscriptions from the
public and that efforts were being made to request the
government for a subsidy.
It was also decided at the meeting to form
Propaganda Corps as from August 1 to conduct propaganda
among the public in order to impress upon the masses the
meaning and importance of the anti-war movement.

The Shun Pao:-

AMERICAN CONSUL'S REPLY TO REPORTS OF BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY
PUBLISHED BY "SHANGHAI EVENING POST".

D.4685.
S

The "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" has
published reports regarding the Blue Shirts Society.
Regarding this as a fabrication intended to defame high
officials of the Government, Mayor Wu Te Chen of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai lodged a protest with the
American Consul-General in Shanghai, and at the same time
warned the newspaper against publishing any more unconfirmed
reports. The newspaper was also requested to publish
a correction of the articles.
The American Consulate-General yesterday gave
a formal reply to the Chinese Municipality, promising
to act in accordance with the request of the latter.

The Sin Wan Pao:-

ABOLITION OF TELEPHONE CALL FEE

The abolition of the 5 cents telephone call fee
by the Shanghai Telephone Bureau of the Ministry of
Communications, was to have been enforced on August 1.
But according to the Chief of the Bureau, no
instructions regarding the abolition have yet been received
from the Ministry, so whether or not the abolition of the
fee can be realized on August 1 is still dubious.
Nevertheless the Chinese authorities are determined to
abolish it.
The Shanghai Telephone Company in the Settlement
is still not in agreement with the abolition. The Ministry
of Communications has already instructed the Bureau of
Public Safety and the Telephone Bureau to negotiate the
matter with the Company concerned.

会议结束后，主席团就欢迎反战联盟代表巴比塞先生（Mr. Barbusse）访华的意义作了报告，并呼吁公众加入世界和平及造福人类的运动。
本报记者从会议的一位代表处获悉，筹备会议的费用系通过公众募捐筹集，目前正努力向政府申请补贴。

美国领事对《上海晚邮报》刊载蓝衣社报道的回复

July 22, 1933.    Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

NICHI-NICHI

DISTRICT KUOMINTANG ISSUES SECRET ORDER FOR ANTI-
JAPANESE MOVEMENT

Recently with the support
of a certain country, a trade corporation was formed by
Chinese to carry out anti-Japanese activities in the
place of the Bloody Corps to Exterminate Traitors.
According to a certain
source, the Shanghai District Kuomintang a few days ago
issued a secret order to the Chamber of Commerce, the
Citizens Federation and other important public bodies
to start an anti-Japanese movement.
The actions of the District
Kuomintang have frequently been contrary to the policy
of the Nanking Government.
For this reason, it is
believed that the District Kuomintang had issued such
an order with the object of embarrassing the National
Government. Therefore, fresh anti-Japanese activities
may be expected.

THE CHINESE MUNICIPALITY AND THE "EVENING POST"

The Nanking Government has
issued an order to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
to take drastic measures to stop the propaganda published
by the "Evening Post", "The Sen Tao Sha" in Canton and
the "China Forum".
These papers have reported
that the Blue Shirts Society is planning to assassinate
55 important politicians including Hu Han Min who are
the political oponents of Chiang Kai Shek.
P
The Chinese Municipality
will lodge a protest with the American Consulate against
Mr. Isaac, the publisher of the "China Forum", and will
warn the "Evening Post.".
In an interview, Mayor Wu
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai stated that he
was surprised to notice the "Evening Post" publisheing
reports fabricated by the "Sen Tao Sha" in Canton and
the "China Forum". These reports were liable to injure
the relations between the Central Government and the
District Governments and arouse personal feeling among
the politicians.
The transportation of the
"China Forum" has already been prohibited by the Nanking
Government because the magazine had been publishing
propaganda for the reds as well as attacks on the National
Government, that the publisher being an American citizen
named Isaac the measures taken against the paper have had
no effect. This time a strong protest will be lodged
with the American Consulate against Isaac.
The local Japanese Consulate
recently issued an order to the Japanese book stores in
Shanghai instructing them not to sell the "China Forum".

《日日新闻》

国民党区党部发布反日运动密令

近期，在某一国家的支持下，华人组建了一家贸易公司，以取代“铁血锄奸团”开展反日活动。据某消息来源称，上海国民党区党部于数日前向总商会、市民联合会及其他重要公共团体发布密令，要求发起反日运动。
该区党部的行动经常与南京政府的政策相悖。因此，人们认为该区党部发布此令旨在使国民政府陷入困境。故此，预计会有新的反日活动出现。

中国市政府与《晚邮报》

南京政府已命令大上海市政府采取严厉措施，制止《晚邮报》、广州的《申屠沙》（音译）(Sen Tao Sha) 以及《中国论坛》刊登的宣传内容。
这些报纸报道称，蓝衣社正计划刺杀包括胡汉民在内的55位重要政治家，这些人均为蒋介石的政治对手。
P
中国市政府将就《中国论坛》出版商艾萨克（Isaac）先生一事向美国领事馆提出抗议，并将警告《晚邮报》。
大上海市政府市长吴铁城在接受采访时称，他惊讶地注意到《晚邮报》刊登了由广州《申屠沙》（音译）和《中国论坛》捏造的报道。这些报道可能会损害中央政府与地方政府之间的关系，并激起政客间的个人情绪。
南京政府此前已禁止《中国论坛》的运输，因为该杂志一直刊登亲共宣传以及对国民政府的攻击，且由于其出版者为一名名为艾萨克（Isaac）的美国公民，针对该报采取的措施未能见效。此次将就该事向美国领事馆对艾萨克提出强烈抗议。
日本驻当地领事馆最近向上海的日本书店发布命令，指示其不得销售《中国论坛》。

July 21, 1933.
Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Min Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

PUBLICATION OF BASELESS REPORTS AGAINST CHIANG KAI SHEK.

The Central Government is highly indignant over the publication on July 19 by the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" of baseless reports issued by the Central Press of Canton, an anti-Government organ, as well as by the "China Forum," a Communist organ. These reports are detrimental to General Chiang Kai Shek, Chief of the Military Affairs Commission, and had been fabricated with the object of injuring his reputation.

A telegram has been dispatched to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai instructing it to warn the "Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury" and to compel it to publish an immediate correction.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

Mayor Issues Statement.

With reference to the publication by the "Evening Post & Mercury" of certain assassination plans of the Blue Shirts Party (a report which is absolutely without foundation), Mayor Wu Te Chen issued the following statement yesterday:-

"On July 19 the 'Evening Post & Mercury' published certain false reports emanating from the Central Press of Canton, a rumour-monger, and the 'China Forum,' a Communist propaganda organ. The black list purported to have been drawn up by the Blue Shirts Party and the statement of this paper are absolutely without foundation. Intelligent people can discern at a glance that the object of the articles is to impair the relations between the Central Government and the leaders of the Kuomintang. Without first making an investigation, the paper published the baseless reports. This will not only affect the general situation, but will cause the people to become panic-stricken. The affair will also seriously affect the reputation of the paper. I deeply regret that this should have happened."

Chen Pao (Nanking telegram):

GAMBLING DEN IN A CERTAIN LEGATION.

According to a confidential report secured by a certain organ of the Government, a certain foreigner, who was deported by Japan, has arrived in Shanghai and immediately entered into arrangements with certain Chinese to establish a big gambling den in the French Concession. The house rented by the foreigner will be used as the Legation of his Government, so as to avert interference by the Police. This Legation is about to remove into the new premises.

As such action on the part of the foreigner not only impairs the prestige of his nation, but constitutes a menace to the Chinese community, the Central Government has instructed the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to suppress the gambling den with the assistance of the French authorities.

杂项

《民报》及当地其他报纸（南京电）：

刊登针对蒋介石的无稽报道。

中央政府对《上海晚邮报与水星报》于7月19日刊登由反政府机关广州中央通讯社以及共产机关《中国论坛》发布的无稽报道感到极为愤慨。这些报道对军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军不利，系为损害其声誉而捏造。

已致电大上海市政府，指令其警告《上海晚邮报与水星报》，并迫使其立即刊登更正声明。

《民报》及当地其他报纸：

市长发表声明。

鉴于《晚邮报与水星报》刊登了有关蓝衣党（该报道完全毫无根据）的某些暗杀计划，吴铁城市长昨日发表如下声明：

“7月19日，《晚邮报与水星报》刊登了来自造谣机构广州中央通讯社以及共产宣传机构《中国论坛》的某些虚假报道。所谓由蓝衣党编制的黑名单以及该报的陈述完全毫无根据。明智之人一眼便能看出，这些文章的目的旨在破坏中央政府与国民党领导人之间的关系。该报未经调查便刊登这些无稽报道。这不仅会影响大局，还会引起民众恐慌。此事也将严重影响该报的声誉。我对发生此事深感遗憾。”

《晨报》（南京电）：

某公使馆内的赌博窝点。

据政府某机关获得的一份机密报告称，一名被日本驱逐的外国人已抵达上海，并立即与某些中国人安排在上海法租界设立大型赌博窝点。该外国人租赁的房屋将用作其政府公使馆，以规避警方干涉。该公使馆即将迁入新址。

由于该外国人的此类行为不仅损害其国家威望，而且对华人社群构成威胁，中央政府已指令大上海市政府在法国当局协助下取缔该赌博窝点。

July 20, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

NIPPO

ACTIVITIES OF THE BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY: 55 IMPORTANT
CHINESE POLITICIANS ON BLACK LIST.

The strange disappearance of a
Chinese well known writer named Ting Ling, who is a member
of the Left Wing, and her sweetheart named Pan Hsiang Nyn
was followed by the assassination of Yang Shang Fu which
came as a great shock to the Chinese community. Since
then all members of the Left Wing including Loo Shing have
gone into hiding.
A few days ago an attempt was made
on General Bah Soong Hshi in Kwangsi Province.
The public is paying serious attention
to these incidents because it is believed that they represent
the activities of a certain party.
According to the Evening Post of
July 19 a secret order has been issued by the Blue Shirts
Society, a white terror gang, to assassinate all important
Chinese politicians in Shanghai and Canton.
According to an English magazine
published by an American named Isaac it has received an
anonymous letter containing the same information published

《日日新闻》

蓝衣社活动：55位中国重要政治家列入黑名单。

左翼成员、知名中国作家丁玲及其情人潘汉年（Pan Hsiang Nyn，音译）的离奇失踪，随后发生了杨杏佛（Yang Shang Fu，音译）被刺案，这在中国社会引起了巨大震动。此后，包括罗惺（Loo Shing，音译）在内的所有左翼成员均已隐匿。
数日前，广西省白崇禧（Bah Soong Hshi，音译）将军遭遇未遂刺杀。
公众正密切关注这些事件，因为人们相信它们代表了某政党的活动。
据7月19日《晚邮报》称，白色恐怖团伙蓝衣社已发布密令，要刺杀上海和广州的所有重要中国政治家。
据一名名为艾萨克（Isaac）的美国人出版的英文杂志称，该杂志收到一封匿名信，其中包含与《晚邮报》刊登相同的信息。一家在广州出版的中国杂志也收到了一封关于蓝衣社刺杀中国政治家密令的信件。
综上所述，近期所有的暗杀行动必定是由蓝衣社策划的。
据《中国论坛》称，蓝衣社于6月15日编制了一份包含55名共产党人和蒋介石政治对手的名单。这些人将被逐一刺杀。杨氏遇害和白将军遇袭均属于该社计划的一部分。杨氏在黑名单编制三天后被杀害。
蓝衣社领袖马少武（Ma Shao Wu，音译）在黑名单编制前一天被杀害。蓝衣社因马氏被杀而加速了其暗杀行动。（注：此处原文逻辑似有矛盾或指代不明，照实翻译）

邹勇（Zau Yoong，音译）、廖仲松（Liao Zung Sung，音译）、李桂生（Li Kwei Sung，音译）。（以上人员为共产党人。）胡汉民、萧佛成（Shiao Vuh Zung，音译）、徐鲁（Tseu Loo，音译）、李济深、陈济棠、李扬敬（Li Yang Ching，音译）、余汉谋、向汉冰（Shiang Han Bing，音译）、黄宁魏（Huang Ning Wei，音译）、邓龙光（Dung Loong Kwang，音译）、李宗仁、张发奎、邓在良（Dung Zai Liang，音译）、桂宗坚（Kwei Tsung Chien，音译）、林茨芒（Ling Ts Mang，音译）、林翼中（Ling Yih Tsong，音译）、钟连柏（Zung Lien Pah，音译）、胡慕兰（Hu Moh Lan，音译）、钟智（Zung Chi，音译）、柏文蔚（Pah Wen Wei，音译），他们均为西南派成员。丹茂星（Dan Mow Sing，音译）、方鼎英、钟绍祖（Zung Shao Zu，音译）、杨虎（Yeong Kuh Wu，音译）、曾子鹏（Tsang Tsu Peng，音译）、曾廷藩（Tsang Ting Fan，音译）、何扎宗（Ho Zah Zung，音译）、钟伟（Zung Wei，音译）、陈铭枢、蒋光奈（Chiang Kwang Nai，音译）、蔡廷锴、曾毅（Tsang Yee，音译）、谭启秀（Tan Chi Siu，音译）、王立泽（Wang Lih Zeh，音译）、钟宗福（Zung Tsong Foo，音译）、孙仲雅（Sun Tsoong Yah，音译）、冯玉祥、方仲吾（Fang Chung Wu，音译）、司徒碧（Sih Tuh Pih，音译）、池宏昌（Chih Hong Chang，音译）、杨亨武（Yang Hen Vuh，音译）、陆醒（Lu Shing，音译）、那敦（Nau Dun，音译）、钟平沃（Zung Ping Wo，音译）、胡雨兹（Hu Yui Ts，音译）、田汉（Dien Han，音译）、吴兆四（Wu Zau Sz，音译）。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Thursday, July 20, 1933

No Blue Shirts, No List;
It's All Wrong, Says Fang

Interviewed today regarding the report which appeared in yesterday's Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury about the alleged existence of a so-called "Blue Shirt Party" and its secret activities. Mr. Fang Chi, Secretary of the Publicity Committee of the Central Party Headquarters, who arrived at Shanghai last evening, denied the truth of the report and branded the alleged document purported to have been issued by the "Blue Shirts" as "a blackmail instrument of the direst nature issued by reactionary elements."
Mr. Fang said that not only is he unaware of the nature of such an organization, but he is ready to guarantee, as a member of the Kuo-mintang, its non-existence. He recalled the statement issued by General Chiang Kai-shek sometime ago in which the Chairman of the Military Commission officially denied the organization of a so-called Blue Shirt Party.
Referring to the China Forum under the editorship of Mr. Harold Isaacs, Mr. Fang asserted that it has always been a radical organ with ulterior motives.
"The City Government of Greater Shanghai," said Mr. Fang, "has long protested against its activities and approached the American Consulate General for its suppression. What appears in this paper, therefore is not worth a penny to believe."

Su, Please attach to file.
JAS
JULY 21, 1933
See also file D 5071

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1933年7月20日，星期四

无蓝衣社，无名单；
全是错的，方说

今日就昨日《上海晚邮报与水星报》刊登的关于所谓“蓝衣党”及其秘密活动 allegedly 存在的报道接受采访。昨晚抵沪的中央党部宣传委员会秘书方治先生否认了该报道的真实性，并将据称由“蓝衣社”发布的文件斥为“反动分子发出的最恶劣性质的勒索工具”。
方先生表示，他不仅不了解此类组织的性质，而且作为国民党党员，他愿意保证该组织并不存在。他回顾了蒋介石将军不久前发表的声明，其中军事委员会主席正式否认了所谓蓝衣党组织的存在。
谈及由哈罗德·艾萨克（Harold Isaacs）先生编辑的《中国论坛》，方先生断言该刊一直是一个带有不可告人动机的激进刊物。
方先生说：“大上海市政府长期以来一直抗议其活动，并向美国总领事馆求助以予以取缔。因此，该报刊登的内容不值一信。”

苏，请归档。
JAS

General Chiang Kai-shek Depicted As Ordering

To Strengthen Personal Power

A mysterious document purporting to emanate from the secret Blue Gown or Chinese Fascist organization and containing orders for wholesale assassinations has been circulated both in Shanghai and in Canton, it was learned today.
A Central Press dispatch from Canton was received by mail today, dealing with this subject, and it was simultaneously learned that the China Forum magazine edited by Mr. Harold Isaacs had received a copy of the document in question from an anonymous source.

General Chiang Involved
The Central Press message directly links General Chiang Kai-shek with the Blue Gown (also known as Blue Shirt, Blue Jacket) movement and declares that he has recently organized his party “to strengthen this personal power.” It asserts that the party “stands for secret assassination of opposition leaders and alliance with Japan in total disregard of Chinese administrative integrity and territorial sovereignty.”
Advance proof of an article to appear in the China Forum was obtained today, including the list of names of those to be assassinated. Mr. Isaacs said he did not know the source of the document sent his office, but that his investigation and inspection had convinced him personally of its authenticity.

Leaders Marked
“The list of people marked for the same end meted out to Yang Chen,” says a portion of the Forum article, “includes the names of the leaders of the Chinese Communist Party and extends in a broad sweep across the Chinese political scene until it reaches Hu Han-min, political leader of the anti-Chiang Opposition in the Kuomintang.
“This document is signed by the
(Continued on Page 8 Col. 4)

character ‘Hua’ which apparently stands for the ruling organ of the Blue Jacket organization. It is dated June 15, i.e., one day after the murder of Ma Chao-wu Blue Jacket chieftain and three days before the murder of Yang Chien, General Secretary of the China League for Civil Rights.

Series Of Murders

The plans were temporarily delayed when certain authorities in the greater Shanghai Municipal Government demurred, stating that wholesale murders would give the city a bad name among the foreigners.”

蒋介石将军被描绘为下令
“蓝衣社”进行谋杀活动
以加强个人权力

据悉，一份据称出自秘密的“蓝衣”或中国法西斯组织、包含大规模暗杀命令的神秘文件，已在上海和广州两地流传。
今日通过邮件收到一篇来自广州的中央通讯社电讯，涉及此主题；同时获悉，由哈罗德·伊萨克斯（Harold Isaacs）先生编辑的《中国论坛》（China Forum）杂志已从匿名来源收到该文件的副本。

牵涉蒋将军

中央通讯社的电讯直接将蒋介石将军与“蓝衣”（亦称蓝衫、蓝夹克）运动联系起来，并宣称他最近重组其党派“以加强其个人权力”。它声称该党派“主张秘密暗杀反对派领导人，并与日本结盟，完全无视中国的行政完整性和领土主权。”
今日获得了将在《中国论坛》上发表的一篇文章的预印样张，其中包括将被暗杀者的名单。伊萨克斯先生表示，他不知道寄到他办公室的文件来源，但他的调查和审查使他个人确信其真实性。

被标记的领导人

《论坛》文章的一部分称：“被列入与杨铨同样命运的人的名单，包括中国共产党领导人的名字，并广泛涵盖中国政治舞台，直至国民党反蒋反对派的政治领袖胡汉民。”
“这份文件署名为‘华’字，显然代表蓝衣组织的统治机构。日期为6月15日，即蓝衣社头目马朝武（音译）被杀后一天，也是中国民权保障同盟总干事杨铨被杀前三天。

系列谋杀案

“在某些圈子里，众所周知，袁健（音译）之死之后将是一系列类似的谋杀，受害者从下列居住在上海的名单中选出。当上海大市政府的某些当局提出异议，称大规模谋杀会给城市在外人中带来坏名声时，计划暂时推迟。”

今日获得了将在《中国论坛》上发表的一篇文章的预印样张，其中包括将被暗杀者的名单。伊萨克斯先生表示，他不知道寄到他办公室的文件来源，但他的调查和审查使他个人确信其真实性。

被标记的领导人

《论坛》文章的一部分称：“被列入与杨铨同样命运的人的名单，包括中国共产党领导人的名字，并广泛涵盖中国政治舞台，直至国民党反蒋反对派的政治领袖胡汉民。”

“这份文件署名为‘华’字，显然代表蓝衣组织的统治机构。日期为6月18日，即陈先生被杀后的第二天...”

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4685
Date 8 / 7 / 33

July 8, 1933. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

MAINICHI

SETTLEMENT POLICE AND BLUE SHIRTS SOCIETY

The activities of the Blue Shirts Society, which was organized by Chiang Kai Shek's clique, have been reported several times.
Since the abduction of a Chinese lady named Ting Ling from the International Settlement, the police authorities of the International Settlement have taken drastic action against the Blue Shirts Society.
The center of the activites of the Society seems to have been removed to the French Concession from the International Settlement.
An attempt has been made by the Society to abduct Liu Roh Yin and Sun Ching Ya, a candidate for membership of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang and a member of Hu Han Min's clique. Sun escape the attack as he was not home at the time. However, a quantity of documents relating to the anti-Chiang Kai Shek movement was seized by the Blue Shirts.
The raid was carried out without first being reported to the French Police.
For this reason, the French Police became very angry and have decided to take drastic measures against the Blue Shirts Society.
The majority of the Chinese detectives in the F French Police are members of the Green Pang of Doo Yueh Seng and some belong to the Red Pang. The members of the Green Pang are related to the Blue Shirts Society and assist the activities of the Society so that the Police can not make investigation. The police will utilize the members of the Red Pang to check the activities of the Blue Shirts Society. In the Police, there are tow different parties, the Reds and Greens opposing each other.
Consequently, several cases of political abduction have taken places in the French Concession.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 登记处。
编号 D 4685
日期 33/7/8

1933年7月8日。晨间译文

杂项

每日新闻

租界警察与蓝衣社

关于蒋介石派系组织的蓝衣社的活动，已有数次报道。
自从一名名叫丁玲的中国女士在国际租界被绑架以来，国际租界的警察当局已对蓝衣社采取严厉行动。
该社的活动中心似乎已从国际租界转移至法租界。
该社曾试图绑架刘罗寅（音译）和孙庆雅（音译），后者是国民党中央执行委员会候补委员，也是胡汉民派系的成员。孙因当时不在家而逃脱了袭击。然而，大量有关反蒋介石运动的文件被蓝衣社缴获。
此次突袭未事先向法国警察报告。
因此，法国警察非常愤怒，并决定对蓝衣社采取严厉措施。
法国警察中的大多数中国侦探都是杜月笙青帮的成员，有些属于红帮。青帮成员与蓝衣社有关联，并协助该社的活动，致使警察无法进行调查。警方将利用红帮成员来遏制蓝衣社的活动。在警察内部，存在两个不同的派系，红帮和青帮相互对立。
因此，法租界发生了几起政治绑架案件。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, JUNE 20, 1933

BLUE SHIRTS FOR
CHINA
New Body to Follow
Prevailing Craze
FROM OUR OWN CORRESPONDENT
Hongkong, June 8.
A gang of semi-Fascists known as "Blue Shirts" have established their headquarters in a luxurious flat in Caine Road, a high class residential district of this Colony. The members are all Chinese and are said to receive financial support from Nanchang and Nanking.
The Blue Shirts are reputed to be admirers of Benito Mussolini and favour fostering a government in China based on dictatorship and the ruthless suppression of the opposition. Many high military commanders in Kiangsu, Kiangsi and Hupeh are reported to be supporters and members of this new political party.
Their activities in Hongkong are quite peaceful, and what they desire is to recruit members who can either wield the pen or engage in daring acts. New members without employment are given about $30 per month, though in the meantime they have no special obligation to the Party except to stand by for orders. Many unemployed but ambitious youths in South China have joined this faction.
Agents are sent to Canton, Kongmoon, Fatshan, Wuchow and Macao to enlist new members. Some join this party purely because of financial inducements, while others desire to back a new movement which is reported to be sponsored by a powerful military figure on the lower Yangtze Valley. These Chinese Fascists believe that strong men are needed to hold the reins of government, hence "Swastika" methods will be used in dealing with political opponents.

Where is Headquarters?
It is learned that the headquarters of this semi-Fascist organisation is located either in Shanghai or Hankow and that money is being remitted here regularly to support the local branch. So far the police have taken no notice of their activities since they are orderly and have no intention whatever to create troubles here.
However, Canton officials take a different view and charge the Blue Shirts as a gang of ruffians paid by self-seeking militarists to further their selfish ends. Mr. Tsou Lu, a leading member of the South-west Political Council and president of the Sun Yat-sen University, accused the Blue Shirts of creating all sorts of annoyance to his institution.
In fact, he said that the recent movements of the undergraduates to oust him and to impeach him at the Ministry of Education at Nanking were the result of the activities of the Blue Shirts. The recalcitrant students attacked President Tsou Lu for having conducted the university in a manner detrimental to the interests of the students.
Tsou Lu hit back and claimed that all the row against him was stage-managed. He even alleged that the Blue Shirts were trying to undermine the Kuomintang at the behest of certain militarists who wish to gain absolute powers in government like Benito Mussolini or Adolf Hitler.
Messrs. Hu Han-min and Liu Lu-yin, former director of propaganda of the Central Party Headquarters, write several articles in the local "Three Principles of the People Monthly" severely attacking the Blue Shirt movement. Being orthodox Kuomintang leaders, they believe the Blue Shirts are no better than the Communists.
Mr. Hu Han-min and his Canton colleagues are loud in their condemnation of the Tangku truce, and they are moving heaven and earth to impeach those persons responsible for the agreement. General Pei Chung-hsi of Kwangsi and General Tang Ting-kai, commander of the 19th route army, telegraphed to Mr. Hu, expressing agreement with his views. Important political developments are expected in the South-west over the whole affair.

（批：d.b. (brine) Information. J.W.L.）

《字林西报》，1933年6月20日，星期二

中国出现“蓝衣社”
新团体追随流行风潮
本报特约记者
香港，6月8日电。一个被称为“蓝衣社”的半法西斯团伙已在本殖民地高档住宅区坚尼道（Caine Road）的一处豪华公寓内设立总部。其成员均为中国人，据称接受来自南昌和南京的资金支持。
蓝衣社据称是贝尼托·墨索里尼的崇拜者，主张在中国建立基于独裁统治并无情镇压反对派的政府。据报道，江苏、江西和湖北的许多高级军事指挥官都是这个新政党的支持者和成员。
他们在香港的活动相当平和，其目的是招募既能执笔写作又能从事大胆行动的成员。没有工作的新成员每月可获得约30元，尽管在此期间他们除了待命听候指令外，对党并无其他特殊义务。华南地区许多失业但富有野心的青年已加入该派系。
代理人被派往广州、江门、佛山、梧州和澳门招募新成员。有些人纯粹因金钱诱惑而加入该党，另一些人则希望支持一场据报由长江下游一位权势军人赞助的新运动。这些中国法西斯主义者认为需要强人来掌控政府大权，因此将采用“卐字”手段来对付政治对手。

总部何在？
据悉，这个半法西斯组织的总部设在上海或汉口，并且定期向这里汇款以支持当地分支。迄今为止，警方并未关注他们的活动，因为他们秩序井然，且无意在此制造任何麻烦。
然而，广州官员持不同看法，指责蓝衣社是一群受自私军阀雇佣以推进其私利的流氓。西南政务委员会重要成员兼中山大学校长邹鲁先生指控蓝衣社给其机构制造了种种麻烦。
事实上，他表示，近期大学生试图罢免他并向南京教育部弹劾他的举动，是蓝衣社活动的结果。这些不服管束的学生攻击邹鲁校长，称其管理大学的方式损害了学生利益。
邹鲁予以反击，声称针对他的所有骚乱均是幕后策划的。他甚至指称，蓝衣社正奉某些军阀之命企图破坏国民党，这些军阀希望像贝尼托·墨索里尼或阿道夫·希特勒那样在政府中获取绝对权力。
胡汉民先生和刘芦隐先生（前中央党部宣传部长）在当地出版的《三民主义月刊》上发表多篇文章，严厉抨击蓝衣社运动。作为正统的国民党领导人，他们认为蓝衣社与共产党并无二致。
胡汉民先生及其广州同僚强烈谴责《塘沽停战协定》，并正竭尽全力弹劾对该协议负责的人员。广西的白崇禧将军和第十九路军司令唐廷凯将军致电胡先生，表示赞同其观点。预计整个事件将在西南地区引发重大的政治发展。

（批：d.b. (brine) 情报。J.W.L.）
